entities.summary: Aleksandra Krystyna Natalli-Świat was a Polish economist and politician. She was elected to Sejm on 25 September 2005, getting 5068 votes in 3 Wrocław district, from the Law and Justice candidate list. In 2007, she was re-elected to the Sejm.

entities.summary: Aleksandra Krystyna Natalli-Świat was a Polish economist and politician. She was elected to Sejm on 25 September 2005, getting 5068 votes in 3 Wrocław district, from the Law and Justice candidate list. In 2007, she was re-elected to the Sejm.
